title: Professional Certificate Course in Introduction to International Tourism
description: This module aims to comprehensively understand international tourism, including its current trends and economic, social, cultural, political, and environmental impacts.
longDescription: Differentiate between International tourists and Domestic tourists. Understand Tourism Dimensions. Know about the Economic importance of tourism. Appreciate the Factors influencing travel. Explore the factors influencing the location of tourism. Understand the tendency of people travels. The aim of this module is to provide a comprehensive understanding of international tourism, including its historical development, current trends, economic, social, cultural, political, and environmental impacts. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn about the following,
courseDetails: This program is designed to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of international tourism and its multifaceted impacts on economies, societies, cultures, politics, and the environment. Through a series of interactive and engaging lectures, discussions, case studies, and group projects, students will gain insights into the complex and dynamic nature of the tourism industry and its challenges and opportunities in the globalized world. In the first few weeks of the program, students will explore the historical development of international tourism and the factors that have contributed to its growth and evolution. They will also analyze current trends in international tourism, such as the rise of sustainable tourism, the impact of technology, and the changing preferences and behaviours of tourists. Additionally, students will critically examine the economic impacts of tourism, including its role in job creation, foreign exchange earnings, and economic development, as well as the potential negative consequences such as overreliance on tourism, leakage, and seasonality.
